newsitem.title: UK: DLR/MARK STRUGGLES OFF LOW BUT REBUFFED AT 1.8600.
newsitem.headline: DLR/MARK STRUGGLES OFF LOW BUT REBUFFED AT 1.8600.

text.p: 0950 GMT - Dollar/mark off session low after shedding gain made on Buba decision to keep repo rate fixed at 3.00 pct, but rise rebuffed near 1.86. Buba makes no further comment on money market activities. Dlr/yen stuck in 115.50-90 range, hampered by weaker dollar/mark and soft mark/yen. Stg shrugs off higher-than-forecast July RPI, underlying rate 3.0 pct vs 2.8 pct expected.
